subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Once they began, they often continued longer.”?
options: He was not fast, but he never missed a day.
They did not want to join loud conversations every day.
Jerry, who hated reading, started with one minute a day.
The next day, more students brought different kinds of paper.
